summary: Customer wants to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to a petroleum process for water determination, with the analyzer outside the process area, so changes can be noticed sooner; they ask what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before selecting equipment.

facts_stated.text: The process stream is a petroleum stream.
Water determination is currently performed by sending samples to a laboratory.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: send samples to a laboratory for water determination

facts_stated.text: The customer wants to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to the process.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: fiber based measurement closer to the process

facts_stated.text: The desired outcome is to notice changes sooner.
The analyzer would be outside the process area.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The analyzer would be outside the process area.

process.value: send samples to a laboratory for water determination
process.enquiry_quote: send samples to a laboratory for water determination

customer_premises.claim: A fiber based measurement closer to the process will allow changes to be noticed sooner.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: fiber based measurement closer to the process so that changes can be noticed sooner

customer_premises.claim: The analyzer can be located outside the process area while still making the required measurement.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: The analyzer would be outside the process area.

customer_premises.claim: It is possible to define what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before selecting equipment.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: Before selecting equipment, we need to know what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish.

unknowns: water concentration range and required detection limit
matrix composition and phase of the petroleum stream
physical state of the stream (liquid, gas, or multiphase)
optical behaviour (clear, turbid, opaque) and spectral interferences
temperature and pressure at the measurement point
installation point and distance to the analyzer outside the process area
required accuracy and response time compared with the laboratory method
details of the laboratory reference method and sampling frequency
cleaning and fouling behaviour of the process stream
